target: Traefik v3.7.16 native configuration: exhaustive file-provider dynamic types plus explicit static/TLS/ACME subtree delegations
exposureRule: Dynamic paths are derived by reaching exported fields from dynamic.Configuration. paerser v0.2.2 file.DecodeContent uses TagFile; only file:"-" excludes a field, file:"allowEmpty" remains exposed, embedded structs flatten, and field lookup is case-insensitive on Go field names. JSON/TOML/YAML/label tags do not decide file exposure. Map keys and typed struct-slice items are represented by * path segments; arbitrary interface payloads remain open-ended. Static and ACME subtrees have separate pinned six-column classifications linked below; delegated is not a runtime-support claim.

sources.purpose: pins the nested dynamic/ext import path
pins nested static metrics exporter types
pins nested listener type catalogue referenced by the static matrix
pins helper-derived OTLPLogs and unsupported experimental fields
pins OCSPConfig and responder override field
pins ACME Configuration and challenge field types
pins provider qualification, ParentRefs, and model application
pins ParentRefs reference, cycle, reachability, and child constraints
pins root field filtering and exported-field behavior
pins case-insensitive Go field matching and file exclusion
